answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 46597 Country: India Title: shajra-e-rasool Question: I want to know about the shajra of Muhammad (s.a.w). Is the present shajra Adam a.s. to Muhammad (s.a.w.) is exactly right or not? Kindly give me your answer in the light of Hadith and Quran. Answer ID: 46597 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1080/1080/M=9/1434) The shajra (ancestral line) of the Prophet (صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم) is proved only till Adnan with authentic Hadiths: محمد بن عبد اللہ بن عبد المطلب بن ھاشم بن عبد مناف بن قصی بن کلاب بن مرۃ بن کعب بن لوی بن غالب بن فھر بن مالک بن النضر بن کنانۃ بن خزیمۃ بن مدرکۃ بن الیاس بن مضر بن نزار بن معد بن عدنان (بخاری 1/543) The line downward is not proved by authentic sources. Even when the Prophet (صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم) mentioned his shajra he would stop at Adnan and say: “mistook those who mention lineage” i.e. they are not true and what they say is unverified. (al-Tabqat al-Kubra, Ibn Sa’d, 1/28- Ref: Seeratul Mustafa 1/18) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
